description: Submit an AI tool to PPToGo's free AI tools directory (pptogo.com/tools) on behalf of its maker. The listing is reviewed by the PPToGo team (typically 2-3 business days); the decision is emailed to contact_email, and once approved it is live at listing_url. One listing per product website — a duplicate returns tool_already_listed with the existing slug. Free listing only; no featured placement is sold through this tool.

contact_email.description: Maker's email for the review decision

has_human_ui.description: Has a web / desktop app people use directly

logo_url.description: Optional public logo URL (SVG or PNG)

long_description.description: Optional detail-page copy in Markdown: what it does, who it is for, links to docs / MCP / API

short_description.description: One sentence shown on the directory card (max 280 chars)

name: submit_tool
